Context: 10. Authorization of Pension and Gratuity

the Head of Office shall take steps to authorize payment of provisional pension and provisional gratuity by the first of the month in which it is due. The provisional pension will be 100% of pension calculated with the available information. The provisional gratuity will also be 100% of gratuity calculated with the available information; but 10% thereof should be withheld for adjustment towards unassessed Government dues. Rule 62.
